name: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
summary: Beldin Steelgrill sends you to learn who has lit a fire above Gol'Bolar Quarry. The camp overlooks the excavation, and the dwarves fear its visitor may mean them harm.

sections.title: A Smoke Plume on the Heights
sections.body: High on the snowy ridges east of Kharanos, a stranger's campfire burns above the quarry. The unfamiliar fire has worried the folk of Kharanos. There, the Mountaineers watch the heights for danger.

sections.title: Meeting the Earthseer
sections.body: Earthseer Farsen has camped on the heights above Gol'Bolar Quarry. He is a mystic bound deeply to the earth, not a marauding trogg or hostile spy. His watch draws him into disturbances beneath Khaz Modan and the mystery of the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the visitor?
faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill, outside Kharanos, asks you to investigate after mountaineers report an unfamiliar fire in the hills.

faq.q: Where is the mysterious campsite located?
faq.answer: The campfire burns high on the snowy ridges east of Kharanos, above Gol'Bolar Quarry.

faq.q: Who is the visitor overlooking the quarry?
faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen is the visitor camped on the heights above the quarry, watching over it.

faq.q: Why were the dwarves suspicious of the campfire?
faq.answer: The dwarves distrust the unknown camp because it overlooks Gol'Bolar Quarry, a critical operation already under pressure from local troggs. They fear scouts or hostile forces may be watching their movements.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
faq.answer: Speaking with Earthseer Farsen leads to Farsen's Watch and begins the Hall of Thanes attunement chain.

faq.q: Do you need to fight the stranger at the camp?
faq.answer: No. Beldin Steelgrill warns you to be ready for violence, but Earthseer Farsen is a peaceful observer who is willing to speak with you.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you know why the Mountaineers watch strangers above major mining sites like Gol'Bolar. They guard Khaz Modan's borders.
As a shaman, you meet Earthseer Farsen, whose communion with the mountain stones is rare in Dun Morogh's snowy highlands.
As an Alliance member, you help the Mountaineers outside Kharanos protect the supply lines and quarry workers from unforeseen threats.
